title: Stories NFT
tagline: A dapp that allows reader to buy stories in NFT
description: Writers are having a hard time making money with their stories.  This dapp help writers make money by allowing them to create their story and upload a file of the story on the dapp.  Users can see the writers works, but they cannot see the full content of the story until they buy it.  When the user buy the story, they will earn NFT which contains a link to the full content of the story.
how_its_made: I did a simple design of the dapp using figma.  I build the front end using Vue with bootstraps 4.  I used solidity with openzeppelin ERC721 contract to build out the smart contract.  The files that the writers upload are stored on pinata and I use the hash that was return from pinata and store it on NFT.
